# has data subject

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasDataSubject`](gmeow-hasDataSubject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasDataSubject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The data subject whose personal data is governed by a rights statement — the individual about whom personal data is processed. Not a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md) because a rights statement (an ODRL policy) is not an agreement; the party model is reused at the licence level.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
